# Nozbe Teams

Cloud-based task management tool helping individuals and teams get organized.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/nozbe-teams/.

## Actions

- **Create Comment**: Add a comment to a task in Nozbe Teams.
- **Create Tag Assignment**: Add a tag assignment to a task.
- **Create Task**: Create a new task in Nozbe Teams.
- **Delete Comment**: Permanently delete a comment by its ID.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a project in Nozbe Teams by its ID.
- **Delete Task**: Delete a task in Nozbe Teams by its ID.
- **Get Project by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a project by its ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **Get Task by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a task by its ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **Get Team by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a team by its ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Retrieve accessible projects with optional filtering.
- **List Tags** (read-only): Get accessible tags from Nozbe Teams.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): Retrieve accessible tasks from Nozbe Teams.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve accessible users from Nozbe Teams.
- **Update Project**: Update a project in Nozbe Teams.
- **Update Task**: Update a task in Nozbe Teams.
- **Update User**: Update a user in Nozbe Teams.
- **Create Attachment**: Add attachment metadata to a comment.
- **Create Project Section**: Create a new project section in Nozbe Teams.
- **Create Reminder**: Add a reminder to a task in Nozbe Teams.
- **Create Team Member**: Add a team member in Nozbe Teams.
- **Create User**: Create a new placeholder user in Nozbe Teams.
- **Delete Reminder**: Delete a reminder by its unique ID.
- **Delete Tag Assignment**: Delete a tag assignment by its ID.
- **Get Attachment** (read-only): Get attachment metadata by its ID.
- **Get Comment by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a comment by its ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **Get Project Access** (read-only): Retrieve project access details by ID.
- **Get Project Section** (read-only): Retrieve a project section by ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **Get Reminder** (read-only): Get a reminder by ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **Get Tag** (read-only): Get a tag by ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **Get Tag Assignment** (read-only): Retrieve a tag assignment by its ID.
- **Get Task Event** (read-only): Get a task event by ID.
- **Get Team Member by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a team member by ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **Get User by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a user by their ID from Nozbe Teams.
- **List Comment Attachments** (read-only): Get all attachments related to a specific comment in Nozbe Teams.
- **List Comments** (read-only): Get accessible comments with optional filtering by task_id and pagination support.
- **List Group Assignments** (read-only): Get accessible group assignments from Nozbe Teams.
- **List Project Accesses** (read-only): Get accessible project accesses in Nozbe Teams.
- **List Project Groups** (read-only): Get accessible project groups from Nozbe Teams.
- **List Project Sections** (read-only): Retrieve accessible project sections with optional filtering.
- **List Reminders** (read-only): Get accessible reminders from Nozbe Teams.
- **List Tag Assignments** (read-only): Get accessible tag assignments with optional filtering by tag_id or task_id.
- **List Task Events** (read-only): Get accessible task events from Nozbe Teams.
- **Poll for new tasks** (read-only): Poll for new tasks created since the last call.
- **Poll Updated Tasks** (read-only): Poll for tasks that have been updated since the last call.
- **Update Comment**: Update an existing comment in Nozbe Teams.
- **Update Project Access**: Update project access permissions in Nozbe Teams.
- **Update Team**: Update a team in Nozbe Teams.
- **Update Team Member**: Update a team member in Nozbe Teams.
